headline: President Prabowo Witnesses 24 Kilometer Flag Display In Nagan Raya
seoTitle: Prabowo Visits Nagan Raya For 24km Flag Event
metaDescription: President Prabowo Subianto visits Nagan Raya, Aceh, to observe a 24-kilometer-long national flag display and inaugurate local community facilities.
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto visited Nagan Raya, Aceh, to observe the deployment of a 24-kilometer-long red and white flag.
The massive fabric display was organized by local residents in an effort to achieve a global record through the Museum Rekor-Dunia.
During his official working visit, the President also performed ceremonies for the inauguration of a local school and a mosque.
aiContextParagraph: President Prabowo Subianto arrived in Nagan Raya, located in the Aceh province, for a scheduled working visit. The primary highlight of the President's itinerary was observing the unfolding of a red and white flag spanning 24 kilometers, an event undertaken by local citizens with the objective of establishing a world record via the Museum Rekor-Dunia. In addition to witnessing the large-scale patriotic display, official reports from the Cabinet Secretariat confirmed that the President's visit included formal inauguration ceremonies for new public infrastructure. Specifically, the President participated in the opening of a mosque and a local educational institution, referred to as a People's School. The event drew significant local participation and was part of a broader official travel agenda that commenced with the President departing from the Halim Perdanakusuma Air Force Base to reach the Nagan Raya region.
whyItIsViral: The event gained high visibility due to the combination of a record-breaking physical spectacle and the high-profile presence of President Prabowo Subianto.
